one_liner: AI document parsing API turning PDFs into LLM-ready structured data

evidence.claim: API key created in free Studio account authenticates requests
API key is sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header
REST API with multiple document-processing endpoints (parse, extract, split, edit, classify, upload, async jobs)
Reducto's own docs ship an official MCP server for tool-style agent calls
evidence.quote: Agent should call Reducto as tools | [MCP server](https://docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server)

evidence.claim: Official Python, Node.js, and Go SDKs plus CLI exist; SDKs auto-read REDUCTO_API_KEY
evidence.quote: **SDKs:** Python (`pip install reductoai`), Node.js (`npm install reductoai`), Go (`go get github.com/reductoai/reducto-go-sdk`)

notes: Vendor documents a Reducto MCP Server page in its own docs (docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server) and an 'Agent Guide' purpose-built for coding agents. Free account gives API keys; billing is usage/credit-based via Stripe with paid monthly/yearly plans, so heavy use costs money. Supports async endpoints with webhooks, usage export API, on-prem/hybrid deployment, and 100MB direct upload (5GB via presigned URL).
